plan.summary: Architect and deploy a full-stack industrial widget factory e-commerce platform on Google Cloud Run featuring an interactive storefront, custom widget configurator, Firestore catalog & inventory ledger, Secret Manager payment validation, and an asynchronous factory fulfillment pipeline triggered via Pub/Sub push subscription.
plan.architecture_overview: Serverless event-driven e-commerce platform with two Cloud Run microservices. The public storefront microservice (FastAPI, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js) serves the catalog, interactive 3D/configurator pricing engine, shopping cart, and order tracking portal, while reading/writing Firestore and validating mock payment keys via Secret Manager. Checkout publishes order events to a Pub/Sub topic (widget-orders-placed). A second Cloud Run microservice (fulfillment-worker) receives order events via a Pub/Sub push subscription, performs atomic stock decrement transactions in the Firestore inventory ledger, generates invoice manifests to Google Cloud Storage, and advances manufacturing status.

infra_tasks.title: Enable Google Cloud APIs and Configure Foundation
infra_tasks.description: Enable all required GCP services: run.googleapis.com, firestore.googleapis.com, pubsub.googleapis.com, storage.googleapis.com, secretmanager.googleapis.com, artifactregistry.googleapis.com, cloudbuild.googleapis.com, and iam.googleapis.com.
acceptance_criteria: All service APIs declared with disable_on_destroy set to false

infra_tasks.title: Provision Storage Buckets, Firestore Native Database, and Secrets
infra_tasks.description: Provision Cloud Storage buckets for public media assets and private invoices with 30-day lifecycle expiration. Initialize Firestore in Native mode and provision Secret Manager secret for mock payment gateway credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Public media bucket and private invoice bucket created
Firestore Native database initialized
Payment gateway secret declared in Secret Manager

infra_tasks.title: Provision Pub/Sub Topic and Factory Fulfillment Push Subscription
infra_tasks.description: Create Pub/Sub topic widget-orders-placed and configure push subscription factory-fulfillment-push-sub targeting /api/v1/factory/process-order with OIDC service account authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Pub/Sub topic created
Push subscription configured with OIDC auth and dead-letter handling

infra_tasks.title: Provision Workload Service Accounts and Least-Privilege IAM
infra_tasks.description: Configure dedicated runtime service accounts for storefront and fulfillment worker with roles for Datastore User, Storage Object User, Secret Accessor, and Pub/Sub Publisher/Invoker.
acceptance_criteria: Least-privilege IAM bindings successfully attached to service accounts

infra_tasks.title: Provision Cloud Run Services for Storefront and Fulfillment Worker
infra_tasks.description: Declare Cloud Run v2 services for storefront and fulfillment-worker scaling to zero instances at idle, binding environment variables for buckets, topics, and Firestore.
acceptance_criteria: Both Cloud Run services declared with min_instances 0
Service URLs exported in outputs.tf

code_tasks.title: Implement Storefront Web Application, Configurator, and Cart Engine
code_tasks.description: Develop FastAPI web application with embedded Tailwind CSS and Alpine.js storefront, dynamic pricing custom widget configurator, Firestore catalog querying, and Firestore seed data initialization on startup.
acceptance_criteria: FastAPI app serves catalog and interactive configurator
Initial 5 manufactured widget SKUs seeded into Firestore on initial boot
Health check GET /healthz returns 200

code_tasks.title: Implement Checkout Pipeline and Pub/Sub Order Publisher
code_tasks.description: Implement POST /api/v1/orders/checkout with Secret Manager payment token validation, order persistence in Firestore customer_orders, Pub/Sub order placement publishing, and GET /track/{order_id} tracking page.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/orders/checkout validates payment and publishes order event
GET /track/{order_id} renders order timeline

code_tasks.title: Implement Factory Warehouse Fulfillment Microservice
code_tasks.description: Develop Cloud Run worker handling POST /api/v1/factory/process-order with Pub/Sub message verification, atomic Firestore inventory deduction in inventory_ledger, invoice creation in Cloud Storage, and order status transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Worker executes atomic inventory decrement transactions
Invoice manifest JSON/PDF saved to invoice bucket
Order status transitioned to QUEUED_IN_FACTORY and MANUFACTURING

code_tasks.title: Implement End-to-End Test Suite
code_tasks.description: Author pytest test cases testing catalog listing, checkout stock decrement transactions, out-of-stock rejection handling, and Pub/Sub fulfillment payload processing with mocked GCP clients.
acceptance_criteria: test_catalog_listing passes
test_order_checkout_atomic_decrement passes
test_out_of_stock_rejection asserts 400 Bad Request
test_fulfillment_worker_pubsub validates order processing
